extraction.notes: No 2027 or 2026 camp schedule was found. The official summer-camps page still lists 2023 dates and prices: Clear View Day Camp July 10–12 at $425 and IEA Camp July 25–26 at $330. Those historical dates and prices are omitted rather than relabeled. Program descriptions and logistics below come from that older page and require confirmation for 2027.

cards.name: Clear View Day Camp
cards.description: Campers take riding lessons and learn horse management and care. Horses and riding equipment are provided, although participants must bring appropriate footwear and helmets.
cards.review_notes: Confirm that this program will run in 2027 and obtain dates, hours, prices and eligibility. The camp page's schedule is explicitly headed 2023 Camp Dates; its lunch and equipment statements are not confirmed for 2026 or 2027. Registration uses a downloadable form submitted by text or email, not an online checkout.

cards.name: IEA Camp
cards.description: Riders learn horsemanship and showmanship with a professional adult instructor. The camp is described as open to middle-school and high-school riders eligible to compete in IEA, including riders who are not on Clear View Farm's team.
cards.review_notes: Confirm 2027 operation, dates, hours, prices and eligibility. The camp schedule is explicitly for 2023. The camp page specifies middle-school and high-school riders, while the general IEA Team page describes IEA as grades 4–12; that general team range was not assigned to this camp. Lunch is stated on the older camp page and needs reconfirmation. Registration uses a form submitted by text or email.
